audit_type: read-only gap audit: regional-skilling-unlocks vs major wiki hubs

policy.present_count: Count of records in regional-skilling-unlocks.json whose regionHints include this region (including multi-region / cross-region rows).
policy.missing_rule: HIGH-VALUE only: permanent tools, outfits, shops, relics, diaries, production infrastructure, or region-defining hubs that materially change no-trade skilling. Training methods / XP rates alone are excluded. Combat-only unlocks excluded unless they are primarily skilling infrastructure.
policy.harshness: If a region-defining hub is only named inside a multi-tool bundle sentence and not as its own planner-visible unlock, it is MISSING. If an elective region has zero skilling rows, that is a critical failure.

worst_gaps: karamja has ZERO skilling unlock records — automatic_early region with Herblore Habitat / juju / Jadinko Lair entirely absent
desert omits entire Menaphos hub (VIP skilling area, reputation tiers, Soul altar, Shifting Tombs) while only tracking Pyramid Plunder / red sandstone / Garden of Kharid
misthalin omits Fort Forinthry building stack beyond Grove/Imcando hatchet (Workshop machines, Town Hall rested XP, Chapel prayer, Command Centre, Botanist's Workbench, Ranger's Workroom)
havenhythe is a starting region with only Ring of Kayazu — missing BGH/apex path, birdhouses, fish farm, Moonrise dig site, empowered obelisks
anachronia omits base camp infrastructure and Orthen dig-site as a hub (only furnace core / bait-and-switch / herb bag named)

missing.name: Fort Forinthry Construction hub (full building stack)
missing.why_important: Wiki lists nine upgradable buildings (Workshop, Town Hall, Kitchen, Chapel, Command Centre, Guardhouse, Grove, Ranger's Workroom, Botanist's Workbench). App only surfaces Tier-3 Grove for Imcando hatchet fragments. Missing: Workshop Invention-machine power + Construction XP, Town Hall rested XP offline/online, Chapel high-rate Prayer + book swap, Command Centre Anachronia worker bonus, Botanist's Workbench Herblore, Ranger's Workroom Fletching. This is the largest starting-region Construction/skilling infrastructure miss.

missing.name: Fort Forinthry Workshop (Invention machines + fort Construction)
missing.why_important: Tier 2–3 Workshop enables remote machine management and +25% machine power capacity. Fort is the practical home for Invention automation while machines themselves are Asgarnia-gated by the Invention Guild — both ends must be modeled.

missing.name: Fort Forinthry Chapel (Prayer altar stack)
missing.why_important: Tiered Prayer XP (200–300%+) on bones/ashes plus herb burners and prayer-book swap inside the fort. Competes with Ectofuntus as a self-contained Prayer infrastructure choice for starting-region planners.

missing.name: Fort Forinthry Town Hall rested experience
missing.why_important: Offline and fort-skilling rested XP converted to bonus XP (cap scales with tier). Permanent multi-skill throughput unlock for the starting region.

missing.name: Mysterious monolith / Archaeology relic harness (global hub at Guild)
missing.why_important: Monolith energy capacity and harnessing every Archaeology relic power is Guild-adjacent starting infrastructure. App tracks individual relics (Bait and Switch) but not the monolith power-cap / energy progression itself as a Misthalin unlock.

missing.name: Memorial to Guthix / engrams (Divination permanent buffs)
missing.why_important: Engrams charge with memory strands for permanent Divination and multi-skill relic-style buffs. Region-local training produces strands globally, but Memorial is Misthalin geography and is a classic ironman permanent-unlock checklist item absent from the file.

missing.name: Varrock Dig Site early Archaeology progression
missing.why_important: Default early dig site and tutorial geography for Archaeology. App has Guild shop but not the dig site as a regional activity unlock.

missing.name: Havenhythe Big Game Hunter + Apex Hide / Masterwork Ranged material path
missing.why_important: Starting-region Hunter 96+ BGH expansion feeds Apex Hide Armour (t85 Ranged) and Masterwork Ranged materials. This is THE Havenhythe skilling power spike for Equilibrium and is completely absent from regional-skilling-unlocks (only appears in major-upgrades-by-region combat notes).

missing.name: Moonrise Dig Site (Archaeology hub)
missing.why_important: First-Age dig site (52+ Archaeology, Secrets of Amberfell). Unlocks collections, mysteries, Hungry Like the Wolf relic power, and Ring of Kayazu chain. App has the ring only — not the dig site hub, collections, or Hungry Like the Wolf.

missing.name: Birdhouses (Hunter 5–101)
missing.why_important: New 2026 clockwork birdhouse method spanning nearly the entire Hunter ladder, exclusive to Havenhythe geography. Permanent low-attention Hunter infrastructure for a starting region.

missing.name: Wendlewick fish farm
missing.why_important: Active multi-pool Fishing method for lobster/swordfish/shark/giant crayfish unique to Havenhythe. Region-defining Fishing infrastructure.

missing.name: Shrine of Inanna empowered obelisks (Summoning)
missing.why_important: Empowered Summoning obelisks with stacking material-save and XP buffs. Starting-region Summoning production infrastructure.

missing.name: Dalia's Tree Nursery + Marigold Farm patch cluster
missing.why_important: Extra tree/fruit-tree/allotment/herb patches plus Heedi eternal-magic sapling plots. Material Farming density for a starting region.

missing.name: Spirit moths + volatile chinchompas (Highweald Hunter)
missing.why_important: Charm supply via spirit moths and high-level chinchompa variant. Summoning/Hunter self-supply loop unique to Havenhythe.

missing.name: Hungry Like the Wolf (Archaeology relic)
missing.why_important: Moonrise Dig Site monolith relic — combat-adjacent but Archaeology-gated regional unlock often valued with skilling region decisions. Not present under any skilling id.

missing.name: Herblore Habitat (juju potion infrastructure)
missing.why_important: ZERO records for automatic_early Karamja is indefensible. Herblore Habitat is the sole source of vine herbs and juju potions (woodcutting, farming, fishing, mining, hunter, etc.). Perfect juju potions define mid/late skilling efficiency across the account. Region-defining Herblore/Farming/Hunter hub.

missing.name: Witchdoctor camouflage outfit + Papa Mambo shop
missing.why_important: Habitat weekly jadinko set rewards the witchdoctor outfit (Hunter XP + teleports to Habitat). Permanent Hunter QoL tied hard to Karamja.

missing.name: Jadinko Lair (curly roots / Woodcutting–Fletching–Firemaking)
missing.why_important: High-level multi-skill lair under Habitat. Curly roots feed Always Adze / Superheat Form style dual-training. Completely absent.

missing.name: Karamja gloves (achievement diary utility)
missing.why_important: Elite gloves teleport, gem mine access, and other diary utilities. Same diary-class as Morytania legs 4 which IS in the file — inconsistent omission.

missing.name: Brimhaven Agility Arena (pirates' hook / tickets)
missing.why_important: Classic Agility minigame with permanent rewards (pirates' hook vanity + XP). Region-locked Agility infrastructure.

missing.name: Shilo Village gem mine / underground mine
missing.why_important: Dense gem rock mining for Crafting self-supply. Early-mid ironman Crafting staple in Karamja.

missing.name: Nature altar (Karamja Runecrafting)
missing.why_important: Nature rune altar is Karamja geography. Nature runes gate high Alchemy and many production loops — altar access matters when Abyss is Forinthry-gated.

missing.name: Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup / hardwood grove
missing.why_important: Teak/mahogany access and tribal currency for hardwood. Construction/Fletching timber supply on Karamja.

missing.name: Invention Guild (skill unlock + machines room)
missing.why_important: CRITICAL. NE of Falador. Invention tutorial + workbench + technology trees + six machine hotspots (Alchemiser, etc.). major-upgrades-by-region already flags it for combat/skill unlock, but regional-skilling-unlocks does not — planners valuing skilling automation cannot see Asgarnia Invention pressure.

missing.name: Crafting Guild
missing.why_important: Bank chest, crafting facilities, soft clay, and guild access for mid-game Crafting. Standard elective-region Crafting infrastructure.

missing.name: Mining Guild / Living Rock Caverns
missing.why_important: Falador Mining Guild + LRC concentrated ore/fish. Core mid-game Mining hub for Asgarnia electives.

missing.name: Warriors' Guild (defender / token shop — combat-edge but token skilling adjacent)
missing.why_important: Lower priority than Invention Guild; included only as note that Asgarnia guild coverage beyond Artisans/FPF is thin. Prefer Invention first.

missing.name: Artisans' Workshop full reward depth (ceremonial swords, cannon upgrades)
missing.why_important: Row exists for blacksmith outfit + luminite injectors but under-specifies ceremonial sword reward track and dwarf multicannon upgrade path as permanent smithing/combat-adjacent unlocks inside the shop.

missing.name: Fishing Guild
missing.why_important: Level 68 Fishing guild bank, shop, and high-density fishing. Deep Sea hub is covered; the Guild itself as permanent infrastructure is not.

missing.name: Barbarian training (Otto — Firemaking/Fishing/Smithing)
missing.why_important: Permanent multi-skill unlocks: barbarian fishing (leaping fish + strength XP), pyre ships, spear/hasta smithing. Lives at Baxtorian / Otto's grotto — Kandarin.

missing.name: Spirit tree network (Tree Gnome Stronghold)
missing.why_important: Farmable spirit trees + Stronghold network are the backbone of ironman travel for patch runs and multi-region logistics. Kandarin owns the hub.

missing.name: Ourania / ZMI altar (Runecrafting)
missing.why_important: Ourania Runecrafting Altar is Kandarin geography and a major mid-game RC method with pure essence multi-rune crafting. Absent.

missing.name: Ardougne cloaks (achievement diary)
missing.why_important: Diary utility (teleports, monastery Prayer bonus, etc.) at same class as Morytania legs which is modeled. Inconsistent diary coverage.

missing.name: Seers' Village headband / diary utility
missing.why_important: Flax, maples, and diary teleports. Kandarin diary set for skilling QoL.

missing.name: Player-Owned Farm full infrastructure (beyond skillchompa supply)
missing.why_important: Manor Farm is mentioned only as skillchompa supply. POF beans, breeding, animal traits, and Farmers' Market depth deserve a dedicated activity row for Farming value of Kandarin.

missing.name: Lunar Diplomacy / Astral altar + Lunar spellbook skilling spells
missing.why_important: Astral altar on Lunar Isle + spells (Plank Make, String Jewellery, Humidify, Fertile Soil, NPC Contact, etc.) are massive multi-skill permanent unlocks. Fremennik owns Lunar geography.

missing.name: Dagannoth Kings dragon hatchet / dragon pickaxe source pressure
missing.why_important: DK waterbirth is Fremennik. Dragon hatchet/pickaxe are the base for crystal tool upgrades and Earth and Song. App tracks Imcando pickaxe and crystal side but not DK as regional tool-base pressure.

missing.name: Fremennik sea boots (achievement diary)
missing.why_important: Diary utility set for Fremennik — same diary class already modeled for Morytania.

missing.name: Stonemason Construction supplies (Keldagrim)
missing.why_important: Bulk Construction materials (gold leaf, marble, magic stone) from Keldagrim stonemason. Critical for high-end POH and fort materials planning under Fremennik geography.

missing.name: Blast Furnace / Keldagrim smithing infrastructure
missing.why_important: Keldagrim hosts smithing infrastructure beyond Lava Flow Mine. Bar production efficiency for ironman Smithing under Fremennik.

missing.name: Enchanted lyre / Rellekka travel unlocks
missing.why_important: Permanent travel QoL after Fremennik Trials chain. Soft infrastructure but high daily-use value.

missing.name: Named Daemonheim permanent unlocks beyond 4 rows (expansive pouch, scroll of life, scroll of proficiency, wild card, etc.)
missing.why_important: Generic daemonheim-skilling-rewards bundle names bonecrusher/charming imp/herbicide/gem bag/autoheater but planners need first-class rows for Scroll of life, Scroll of proficiency, Expansive pouch, Gemstone golem outfits fragments path, and other high-token skilling perms — same treatment already given to cleansing/efficiency/autoheater.

missing.name: Abyss Runecrafting entrance (Mage of Zamorak)
missing.why_important: Abyss is Forinthry/Wilderness. Gates efficient RC including Time runes combo with Anachronia altar. Combo audit already flags this; still no first-class regional skilling unlock row.

missing.name: Wilderness sword / Wilderness achievements diary
missing.why_important: Sword teleports + Abyss magical-thread boost + multi-skill diary utilities. Forinthry diary equivalent of Morytania legs.

missing.name: Demonic skull (Wilderness skilling XP)
missing.why_important: Optional risk XP lamp-style boost for Wilderness skilling. Region-defining risk/reward skilling toggle.

missing.name: Always Adze (Warforge / Into the Forge — Seed of the Charyou Tree)
missing.why_important: Monolith relic auto-burns logs for Firemaking XP while Woodcutting. Unlock path is Warforge Dig Site / Thalmund's Forge (Daemonheim dig site — Forinthry). Superheat Form alternative without prayer drain. Only mentioned in Superheat Form notes, not as its own Forinthry relic unlock.

missing.name: Daemonheim Dig Site (Warped Depths archaeology)
missing.why_important: Dig site that gates Skeka's hypnowand journal and Balarak's brush pieces. Present only as cross-region equipment pressure, not as the dig site hub itself.

missing.name: Menaphos city skilling hub (reputation + districts)
missing.why_important: CRITICAL. Menaphos is a Prif-tier mid/high skilling city: acadia WC, mineral deposits, desert sole/catfish/beltfish, marketeer thieving, plover hunter, district banks, and permanent reputation rewards. App has three desert rows and ZERO Menaphos. Equivalent gap to omitting Prifddinas from Tirannwn.

missing.name: VIP skilling area (Tier 7 overall reputation)
missing.why_important: Half-depletion acadia/mineral/fish with bank chest. Signature Menaphos permanent unlock for banked multi-skill AFK.

missing.name: Soul altar (Menaphos Imperial district)
missing.why_important: Level 90+ Soul rune crafting altar under Menaphos fountain after 'Phite Club. High-value Runecrafting infrastructure hard-locked to Desert/Menaphos.

missing.name: Shifting Tombs
missing.why_important: Multi-skill XP minigame + reputation + Menaphite gift offerings. Core Menaphos activity loop.

missing.name: Menaphos district skilling boosts (Tier 8 reputation)
missing.why_important: Permanent success/damage boosts for WC (Imperial), Fishing (Port), Thieving (Merchant), Mining (Worker), including VIP area. Permanent throughput unlocks.

missing.name: Player-owned port (Port district entry)
missing.why_important: Ports portal is in Menaphos Port district. Ports is major mid-game resource (trade goods, scroll of proficiency mats, Eastern lands). Desert/Menaphos is the canonical entry.

missing.name: Desert amulet (achievement diary)
missing.why_important: Diary teleports and utilities. Same class as Morytania legs 4 which is modeled.

missing.name: Mage Training Arena rewards
missing.why_important: Bones to peaches unlock, wand progression, infinity ethereal pieces path adjacency. Al Kharid / desert MTA is a permanent Magic/skilling utility shop.

missing.name: Het's Oasis (Farming/Agility)
missing.why_important: Post-2022 desert skilling hub with unique Farming/Agility content near Al Kharid.

missing.name: Blood altar
missing.why_important: Blood rune altar is Morytania geography (Meiyerditch). Blood runes gate ancient spells and high-end Magic. Hard region lock for RC.

missing.name: Vyre corpse cremation Prayer training
missing.why_important: Darkmeyer/vyre corpses + Sunspear cremation is a premier Prayer method. Legs 4 mentions the XP boost but the activity/source is not a first-class row.

missing.name: Werewolf Agility Course
missing.why_important: Morytania Agility course with skullball adjacency. Region Agility infrastructure.

missing.name: Polypore Dungeon (Farming spores / Magic training resource)
missing.why_important: Polypore stick + spore farming resource dungeon. Mid-game Magic/Farming adjacency in Morytania.

missing.name: Canifis / Port Phasmatys Farming patches (mushroom)
missing.why_important: Mushroom patch and Canifis patches double with legs 4. Farming infrastructure density.

missing.name: Drakan's medallion teleports
missing.why_important: Post-quest permanent teleport network across Morytania (Barrows, Darkmeyer, etc.). High daily-use travel infrastructure.

missing.name: Grace of the elves
missing.why_important: BIS skilling necklace: Seren prayer drain reduction (Light Form / Superheat Form / Chronicle Attraction), 500–2000 porter charges, Seren spirit rare drops while gathering, Max Guild portal teleports. Prif/alchemical-onyx chain is a defining Tirannwn gathering unlock. Completely absent.

missing.name: Light Form + Crystal Mask (Seren prayers beyond Superheat Form)
missing.why_important: Light Form (thieving/divination focus) and Crystal Mask are Seren prayer skilling unlocks from The Light Within. Only Superheat Form is modeled — incomplete Seren skilling prayer set.

missing.name: Hefin Agility Course + Serenity posts
missing.why_important: Premier high-level Agility course with Voice of Seren Prayer XP, course multipliers, worker robes. Prif Agility is not represented outside the generic hub blurb.

missing.name: Max Guild (Prifddinas)
missing.why_important: Skill portals, thrall of the max guild teleports, gathering hub. Requires Prif access + 99s. Major late-game Tirannwn infrastructure.

missing.name: Crystal tree Farming (crystal acorns)
missing.why_important: Unique Prif Farming tree for crystal weapon seeds / harmonic-adjacent rewards. Named crystal skilling content missing as a row.

missing.name: Cleansing crystals (Hefin Prayer)
missing.why_important: AFK Prayer method in Hefin cathedral using cleansing crystals. Complements Superheat Form / Hefin package.

missing.name: Amlodd Divination / Cadarn hunting district features
missing.why_important: District-specific high-level gathering under Voice of Seren. Hub blurb mentions Voice of Seren rotations but not Amlodd/Cadarn as planner-visible unlocks.

missing.name: Ancient elven ritual shard
missing.why_important: Prayer restore on cooldown that pairs with Grace of the elves for sustained Superheat Form / Light Form. Common Tirannwn skilling stack piece.

missing.name: Anachronia base camp (full infrastructure)
missing.why_important: CRITICAL. Town Hall / Storehouse / Sleeping Quarters / Spa / Hunter Lodge / Slayer Lodge / Player Lodge / bank / lodestone / remote totem access. Worker material economy feeds dinosaur farm and Dream of Iaia. App has zero base-camp rows.

missing.name: Orthen Dig Site (full hub)
missing.why_important: Level 90–120 Archaeology dig site with four excavation sites, teleport devices, collections, mysteries, potion recipes, skilling off-hands, relics, and +150 monolith power at 120. App only extracts furnace core + bait-and-switch — not the dig site as a region-defining Archaeology hub.

missing.name: Anachronia Big Game Hunter (classic dinosaurs + dragon mattock)
missing.why_important: Original BGH for Hunter XP and dragon mattock (crystal mattock base). Distinct from Havenhythe BGH. Also feeds Skeka's hypnowand piece pressure.

missing.name: Anachronia Dinosaur Farm (Ranch Out of Time)
missing.why_important: Dinosaur breeding/Farming extension of POF. Beans market, unique produce, max-guild portal unlock purchase. Major Anachronia Farming unlock.

missing.name: Anachronia Agility Course
missing.why_important: High-level Agility course with totem pieces and dinosaur materials. Region Agility infrastructure.

missing.name: Anachronia totems (multi-skill permanent buffs)
missing.why_important: Buildable totems (xp, drop cleaners adjacency, combat, etc.) from Agility/island materials. Permanent account-wide buffs gated by Anachronia progress.

missing.name: Dream of Iaia skilling stations
missing.why_important: End-game multi-skill AFK stations fed by base-camp materials. Region-defining late Anachronia infrastructure.

missing.name: Time altar (Anachronia Runecrafting)
missing.why_important: Time runes altar on Anachronia. Cross-region with Forinthry Abyss for efficient runs. Masterwork staff chain pressure.

missing.name: Player Lodge skillcape rack + Slayer helmet stand
missing.why_important: Base camp Tier-3 Player Lodge skillcape rack and Slayer Lodge helmet stand grant passive cape/helmet effects without wearing them — huge permanent QoL unique to Anachronia base camp upgrades.

global_missing.name: Grace of the elves (crafted; alchemical onyx)
global_missing.why_important: Account-wide gathering necklace; not strictly one-region but Prif/Tirannwn access and high Crafting/Magic define practical obtain. Missing entirely from regional file despite being top-tier skilling equipment.

global_missing.name: Signs of the porter / porters as system
global_missing.why_important: Divination porter charges power Grace and all gathering. Not modeled as a supply unlock (Divination energy + signs).

global_missing.name: Invention machines as system (not just guild location)
global_missing.why_important: Alchemiser, auto-disassembler, etc. are permanent production infrastructure. Split across Asgarnia (guild) and Misthalin (Fort Workshop power).

global_missing.name: Achievement diary set coverage is incomplete
global_missing.why_important: Only Morytania legs 4 is first-class. Karamja gloves, Desert amulet, Ardougne cloaks, Fremennik sea boots, Wilderness sword, Seers headband missing. Diaries are permanent multi-skill utility by design.

global_missing.name: The Arc / Uncharted Isles (Ports eastern lands)
global_missing.why_important: Chimes, supplies, waiko shop, uncharted resources. Entered via Menaphos Ports / Ports system. Major mid-game skilling island set not in regional-skilling-unlocks.

global_missing.name: Crystal mattock (named tool)
global_missing.why_important: Crystal tool workshop lists mattock in unlock text but there is no equipment row for crystal mattock (unlike rod/hammer/tinderbox). Dragon mattock is Anachronia BGH pressure.

global_missing.name: Mattock of Time and Space
global_missing.why_important: End-game Archaeology mattock using energised meteorite shard from Guild shop (present in guild row text) plus other components. No first-class equipment chain row.

methodology_notes: Compared data/research/regional-skilling-unlocks.json (54 records, snapshotDate 2026-07-26) against major wiki region/hub pages.
present_count includes multi-region rows that list the region in regionHints.
Combat gear, boss drops, and pure XP methods intentionally deprioritized unless they are tools/outfits/shops/relics/infrastructure.
Fort Forinthry mapped to Misthalin per league regions hardRules / Catalyst precedent noted in-file.
City of Um / Underworld content already partially present under Misthalin taxonomy; Fort buildings still under-modeled.
This audit does not edit regional-skilling-unlocks.json (read-only).
